fileDescription: Strings for the 'Tilt Shift Mouse Follow' effect.

sgtconti_tilt_shift_mouse_follow.name: Tilt Shift Mouse Follow
sgtconti_tilt_shift_mouse_follow.description: Tilt-shift band, ellipse focus, or radial focus following a layout position. Can sample the background when used as a layer effect. Supports WebGL and WebGPU.

mouseX.name: Focus X
mouseX.desc: Layout X coordinate of the focus point.

mouseY.name: Focus Y
mouseY.desc: Layout Y coordinate of the focus point.

focusSize.name: Focus size
focusSize.desc: Distance around the focus kept sharp.
